label: All individuals diagnosed with NSCLC between 1-1-2022 and 31-12-2024 and registered in the NCR
AND started nivolumab + ipilimumab or pembrolizumab
AND started index or reference drugs within 90 days from NSCLC diagnosis
AND have a stage IV cancer
AND have a PDL1 expression of < 1%
AND have NO actionable EGFR, ALK or ROS1 mutation
AND have NO previous malignancy/ cancer treatment
AND started chemotherapy between -28 and 0 days
